label: Lives-only act consequentialism: intervening is permissible iff it costs no more lives
definition: ActConsequentialist c: intervening is permissible exactly when its death count does not exceed that of refraining. Only deaths are counted; ties are permitted.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
